recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. The current source satisfies the FHIR-14283 capability and restoring older CarePlan/RequestGroup wording or duplicating Questionnaire guidance would conflict with later approved refinements.
issue_request: FHIR-14283 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 and requested PlanDefinition realization guidance for CarePlan/RequestGroup results plus expansion of the action definition element so a Questionnaire can represent a data-collection step.
initial_application: GF#14283 commits 745e5821c8 and d2ee3b22ca applied the issue in 2018 by adding Questionnaire to PlanDefinition.action.definition and updating the Applying a PlanDefinition narrative for PlanDefinition and Questionnaire actions, matching the Jira comments for SVN 13263 and SVN 13327.
additional_context: RequestGroup was later renamed to RequestOrchestration by FHIR-24619. FHIR-33169 and FHIR-46313 later refined PlanDefinition/$apply output from the older CarePlan/RequestGroup framing to Bundle results that may include CarePlan, RequestOrchestration, and individual request resources. FHIR-49988 considered narrowing action.definition but ultimately preserved Questionnaire-style definitional resources and documented Task-with-focus realization.
reconciliation: No source change was made. PlanDefinition.action.definition[x] and RequestOrchestration.action.definition[x] both allow Questionnaire and say it should be filled out, while PlanDefinition realization and operation text already reflect the later approved Bundle/request-resource semantics.
